Fieldbook 1.4.2: voice typing on phone and tablet

- Mic button in the add bar and in task title/notes and note title/body
  (Android app only; uses the device's speech recognition)
- Spoken add-bar shorthand: "9 a.m." -> 09:00, "hashtag lab" -> #lab,
  "high priority" -> !high, "new note ..." -> note:
- Listening bar with Done/Cancel and language choice (Device, English, Khmer)
- Clear messages when the device has no speech service or the mic is not allowed
